001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.nio.file.Path;
005import java.nio.file.Paths;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import java.util.Objects;
009import java.util.Set;
010import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
011import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
012
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputProvider;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ListLogOutput;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.StdErrOutputBuilder;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.StdOutOutputBuilder;
017
018/**
019 * Register output providers by URI scheme.
020 */
021public sealed interface LogOutputRegistry extends OutputProvider permits DefaultOutputRegistry {
022
023        /**
024         * The URI scheme for list provider.
025         */
026        public static String LIST_OUTPUT_SCHEME = "list";
027
028        /**
029         * Register a provider by {@link URI#getScheme() scheme}.
030         * @param scheme URI scheme to match for.
031         * @param provider provider for scheme.
032         */
033        public void register(String scheme, OutputProvider provider);
034
035        /**
036         * Attempts to reopen all outputs of a certain type usually for log rotation. This
037         * call will block if it attempts to reopen. If reopening is already happening an
038         * empty list will be returned.
039         * @return alert events for outputs that failed to reopen, or an empty list if
040         * reopening was skipped or every output reopened successfully.
041         */
042        public List<LogEvent> reopen();
043
044        /**
045         * Attempts to flush all outputs usually for log rotation. This call will block if it
046         * attempts to flush. If flush is already happening an empty list will be returned.
047         * @return alert events for outputs that failed to flush, or an empty list if flushing
048         * was skipped or every output flushed successfully.
049         */
050        public List<LogEvent> flush();
051
052}
053
054final class DefaultOutputRegistry implements LogOutputRegistry {
055
056        /*
057         * Only the names: an output belongs to its appender, which decides when it is written
058         * to, flushed and closed, so the registry does not hand outputs out.
059         */
060        private final Set<String> names = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
061
062        private final Map<String, OutputProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
063
064        private final ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;
065
066        private final ReentrantLock reopenLock = new ReentrantLock();
067
068        static LogOutputRegistry of(ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
069                var r = new DefaultOutputRegistry(serviceRegistry);
070                for (var p : StandardLogOutputProvider.values()) {
071                        r.register(p.scheme(), p);
072                }
073                return r;
074        }
075
076        public DefaultOutputRegistry(ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
077                this.serviceRegistry = serviceRegistry;
078        }
079
080        @Override
081        public List<LogEvent> reopen() {
082                return requestIO(LogAction.StandardAction.REOPEN);
083        }
084
085        @Override
086        public List<LogEvent> flush() {
087                return requestIO(LogAction.StandardAction.FLUSH);
088        }
089
090        private List<LogEvent> requestIO(LogAction action) {
091                if (reopenLock.tryLock()) {
092                        try {
093                                return _request(action);
094                        }
095                        finally {
096                                reopenLock.unlock();
097                        }
098                }
099                else {
100                        return List.of();
101                }
102        }
103
104        private List<LogEvent> _request(LogAction action) {
105                /*
106                 * TODO check rainbowgum is actually running.
107                 */
108                return Actor.act(serviceRegistry.find(LogAppender.class).stream().map(a -> InternalLogAppender.of(a)).toList(),
109                                action);
110        }
111
112        @Override
113        public void register(String scheme, OutputProvider provider) {
114                providers.put(scheme, provider);
115        }
116
117        private LogOutput _register(String name, LogOutput output) {
118                if (!names.add(name)) {
119                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Name is already in use. name = '%s'".formatted(name));
120                }
121                return output;
122        }
123
124        static URI normalize(URI uri) {
125                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
126                String path = uri.getPath();
127                String query = uri.getRawQuery();
128                if (scheme == null) {
129                        if (path == null) {
130                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri));
131                        }
132                        if (path.startsWith("./")) {
133                                uri = Paths.get(path).toUri();
134                                if (query != null) {
135                                        uri = URI.create(uri.toString() + "?" + query);
136                                }
137                        }
138                        else {
139                                uri = URI.create(path + ":///" + (query == null ? "" : "?" + query));
140                        }
141                }
142                else if (scheme.equals("file")) {
143                        if (path == null) {
144                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("File URI has no path: " + LogRedactor.redactUri(uri)
145                                                + ". Use file:///var/log/app.log, or ./app.log or file:///./app.log for a file in the working directory.");
146                        }
147                        if (path.startsWith("/./")) {
148                                uri = Paths.get(path.substring(1)).toUri();
149                        }
150                        else {
151                                /*
152                                 * Path.of(URI) rather than the decoded path, which on Windows is /C:/...
153                                 * and not a valid path.
154                                 */
155                                uri = Path.of(URI.create("file://" + uri.getRawPath())).toUri();
156                        }
157                        if (query != null) {
158                                uri = URI.create(uri.toString() + "?" + query);
159                        }
160                }
161                return uri;
162        }
163
164        private static LogProviderRef normalize(LogProviderRef ref) {
165                var uri = normalize(ref.uri());
166                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, ref.keyOrNull());
167        }
168
169        @Override
170        public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
171                ref = normalize(ref);
172                var uri = ref.uri();
173                String scheme = Objects.requireNonNull(uri.getScheme());
174                OutputProvider customProvider = providers.get(scheme);
175                if (customProvider == null) {
176                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.OUTPUT, scheme, uri,
177                                        providers.keySet());
178                }
179                var _ref = ref;
180                return (name, config) -> {
181                        return _register(name, customProvider.provide(_ref).provide(name, config));
182                };
183        }
184
185        enum StandardLogOutputProvider implements LogOutput.OutputProvider {
186
187                STDOUT {
188                        @Override
189                        public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
190                                return (s, c) -> new StdOutOutputBuilder(s).fromProperties(c.properties(), ref).build().provide(s, c);
191                        }
192
193                        @Override
194                        public String scheme() {
195                                return LogOutput.STDOUT_SCHEME;
196                        }
197
198                },
199                STDERR {
200                        @Override
201                        public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
202                                return (s, c) -> new StdErrOutputBuilder(s).fromProperties(c.properties(), ref).build().provide(s, c);
203                        }
204
205                        @Override
206                        public String scheme() {
207                                return LogOutput.STDERR_SCHEME;
208                        }
209
210                },
211                LIST {
212                        @Override
213                        public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
214                                return (s, c) -> new ListLogOutput();
215                        }
216
217                        @Override
218                        public String scheme() {
219                                return LIST_OUTPUT_SCHEME;
220                        }
221
222                };
223
224                public abstract String scheme();
225
226        }
227
228}
